Subject: Procurement onboarding: schedule kickoff, intake cadence & success criteria

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for moving this forward. We’d like to get a 30–45 minute kickoff on the calendar to align on the vendor intake steps, PO path, and a short mutual action plan so both teams know owners and timing. Suggested agenda below.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- Introductions + roles (5m)
- Vendor intake checklist walkthrough (10m) — onboarding_checklist.xlsx attached
- PO process & timeline (10m) — PO form, invoice cadence, expected lead-times
- Success criteria & handoff (5m) — test calls, log access, billing contact
- Next steps / owners / target dates (5–10m)

A few notes up front:
- I’ve attached our onboarding checklist and W-9. We can send bank details and the SOW draft after the kickoff when procurement confirms the PO flow.
- If Aperture needs a vendor portal upload link or a prefilled vendor form, we can prepare that ahead of the call — please let us know which internal team will own the intake (procurement admin vs. business sponsor).

Proposed times (Pacific):
- Tue 9/1 10:00–10:30
- Tue 9/1 14:00–14:45
- Wed 9/2 11:00–11:45

If none of those work, share a couple windows and we’ll adjust. I’m looping in Ben (AE) and Lauren (Finance) so we can answer PO/pricing questions and billing details.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Tue 9/1 at 14:00 PT works best for us. I’ve added our procurement mailbox and Kyle (vendor ops) to the thread — Kyle will be the one to complete any vendor portal forms and confirm the PO number once the SOW is finalized.

Quick Qs before the call:
- We typically require an ACH remittance form + W-9 + attestation for data handling. W-9 looks good; can you confirm who on your side owns bank details (we usually accept a PDF from finance or a secure DocuSign).
- Our PO process: procurement issues a PO after legal and finance sign off. Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts a standard 45-day payment term or if a 30-day term is required for this pilot?
- For the MAP, we track two milestones to close: SOW signed and first invoice issued. Could you propose target dates for each on the call?

Appreciate you looping in the right folks — looking forward to 9/1.

Best,
Maya

- MAP targets (initial proposal):

  • PO issued by Aperture / first invoice: 2026-09-17
  • Production access (read-only) for Aperture devs: 2026-09-24

Attachments I’ll circulate post-call: SOW-draft.docx and our onboarding support playbook. For the call, we’ll plan to: walk the checklist, confirm intake owner (Kyle), confirm legal/finance touchpoints, and set the PO issuance date.

See calendar invite (sent).
